description: This Java source file defines the AppUsageStatisticsFragment class, which is a Fragment used in an Android application to display app usage statistics. It utilizes the UsageStatsManager API to retrieve usage data, provides a user interface with RecyclerView and Spinner for selecting time intervals, and includes logic for updating and sorting the usage data.

classes.name: AppUsageStatisticsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays app usage statistics, allowing users to select different time intervals and view usage data in a list.

classes.name: LastTimeLaunchedComparatorDesc
classes.description: A comparator for sorting UsageStats objects in descending order based on the last time the app was used.

classes.name: StatsUsageInterval
classes.description: An enumeration representing time interval options for usage statistics (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly).

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the UsageStatsManager instance when the fragment is created.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components, adapters, and event listeners after the view has been created.

methods.name: getUsageStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves app usage statistics for a specified interval from UsageStatsManager.

methods.name: updateAppsList
methods.description: Updates the RecyclerView with new usage data, fetching app icons and preparing display data.
